items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 26 at 11:38AM EST until November 26 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip
currents. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal
flooding expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Duval County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 7 PM EST this
evening. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 7 PM this
evening to 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur. Rip
currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into
deeper water.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 26 at 11:39AM EST until November 27 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 5
to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast Georgia and Northeast Florida coastal waters
from Altamaha Sound GA to Flagler Beach FL out to 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
